pinterest.title: How to Build a Reliable AI Coding Harness
pinterest.description: Stop relying on secret prompt tricks. Learn how to build a reliable AI coding harness using repository instructions, execution boundaries, and human review gates. Perfect for solo developers. Read more: https://payhip.com/b/vGks8Produced with AI assistance and released with human approval by Clearforge.

snippet.title: Beyond the Prompt: Why AI Automation Depends on Protocols, Harnesses, and Human Review
snippet.description: Shift your focus from prompt tweaking to workflow containment.
